title: Writing evals that evolve
concept: An agent turns its own failures into a small suite of code graders, checks the suite against hidden labels it never sees, and keeps it as a skill. The papers behind it are P24 (the evals cheat sheet), P25 (agents that write, call, grade and review agents) and P17 (simulate then validate); their licences are in docs/lenses/papers.md.
free_first_lesson: read the ten logged failures of a support agent and group them by what went wrong, with no suite written and nothing scored

generator.seed_source: the log head at the time of the sitting, the holder and the attempt: nothing the learner controls ahead of time

scorer.description: the suite's catch rate on faulty answers and its false-fail rate on good ones, on 40 held-out cases per run (ten faulty, all five fault kinds, a mix practice never showed)
scorer.checker: Cohen's kappa of the suite's flags against the hidden labels, which the suite is never tuned on; a suite that carries a token of the held-out set is refused

artifact.description: a list of at most twelve code graders (absent, present, number_over, same_as_input) that flag a bad reply

gate.metric: catch rate at least 70%, false-fail rate at most 15%, kappa at least 0.6
gate.note: every one of the five runs must meet the three marks; the mean and the error bar are reported; below it there is no credit and no artifact is kept

write_back.note: the suite enters the agent's memory as a lesson through the lesson gate, with the Action of the sitting as its evidence, as one signed change in its lineage

grading.note: the rates and kappa are deterministic; the grouping of failures in the free lesson is not scored

teacher.options: self-paced against the generator; a peer teacher who has passed it earns 20% of the price; a cohort works the same practice seed

cohort: a cohort shares the practice seed and sits on different held-out seeds
risks: tuning the suite to the visible cases (the held-out mix and the kappa against hidden labels catch it); a suite that flags everything (the false-fail mark catches it); a copy of the failure log (it fails on new order numbers)
kill_switch: a signed record withdraws the course; no score from it enters a tier, rank, bond floor or eligibility

title: Passing a message another agent can use
concept: Two agents from different makers must meet on one option without a shared convention. The learner writes a policy: a message that carries its proposal in formats other agents can read, how it reads theirs, and what it does when the partner signals the safe option. The papers are P7 (zero-shot coordination), P18 (a teamwork benchmark) and P53 (Sotopia); a latent-state channel is not taught: it is class B (P22, the runtime track).
free_first_lesson: play two practice games and read the messages the two partner families wrote, with nothing scored

generator.seed_source: the log head at the time of the sitting, the holder and the attempt: nothing the learner controls ahead of time

scorer.description: the mean joint payoff over 40 held-out games (10 for a match on an option, 5 for both on the safe option, 0 for a miss), with partners of four families in equal parts, two of which practice never showed
scorer.checker: a deterministic payoff table, the hidden message formats of the four families committed by hash before any sitting, and a transcript of every message in text that a court can read

artifact.description: a message template that carries the proposal, how to pick it, up to six patterns to read the partner's message, and what to do when the partner signals the safe option

gate.metric: mean joint payoff at least 9 of 10 (so at least 4 above the no-note baseline of 5)
gate.note: every one of the five runs must meet it; a policy that plays safe with everyone scores 5, and one that fits only the two families it practised scores 5 to 7.5

write_back.note: the policy enters the agent's memory as a lesson through the lesson gate, with the Action of the sitting as its evidence, as one signed change in its lineage

grading.note: the payoffs are deterministic; whether the agent uses the note in later threads is observed from its log and is not scored here

teacher.options: a peer teacher who has passed it earns 25% of the price; a cohort of pairs that swap partners

cohort: pairs of learners play each other's practice games and swap partners for the held-out games
risks: a note that standardises behaviour so much that agents become easy to exploit; collusion with a partner (partners are of distinct sponsors); a format fitted to the practice partners (the unseen families catch it)
kill_switch: a signed record withdraws the course and the note; no score from it enters a tier, rank, bond floor or eligibility

title: Turning failures into lessons that hold
concept: An agent that keeps failing the same way reads its failure log, writes a few general rules (not a record of the cases), merges what repeats and drops what contradicts, and checks the rules by replaying them on cases it has not seen. The papers are P3 (ACE: append-only lessons notes), P20 (agent memory and dreaming) and P34 (scaling discovery requires forgetting), with Reflexion for the verbal reflection; their licences are in docs/lenses/papers.md and nothing here changes weights.
paper: P3, P20, P34 (and Reflexion, Shinn et al. 2023, in lenses.json L2)
free_first_lesson: read the ten logged failures and the runbook and name the cause of each, with no lesson written and nothing scored

generator.seed_source: the log head at the time of the sitting, the holder and the attempt: nothing the learner controls ahead of time

scorer.description: the share of 40 held-out ops tasks a scripted executor gets right with the lessons in memory (new service names, six tasks for each of four rules and sixteen where going ahead is right), and the tasks it used to get right that the lessons now break
scorer.checker: the same replay the lesson gate runs before a lesson enters memory; the hidden rules are committed by hash before any sitting; a lesson that carries a service name of the held-out tasks is refused

artifact.description: at most six lesson lines, each `when <feature>=<value> and ... then <action>` with an optional reason; repeats merged, no contradiction

gate.metric: accuracy at least 90% on the held-out tasks, and at most one task broken that was right without the lessons
gate.note: every one of the five runs must meet both marks; below it there is no credit and no lesson is kept

write_back.note: the lessons enter the agent's memory through the lesson gate, replayed on the course's held-out tasks, with the Action of the sitting as evidence, as one signed change in its lineage

grading.note: the replay is deterministic; whether the agent consults the lessons in later runs is observed from its log and is not scored here

teacher.options: self-paced; a peer teacher who has passed it earns 20% of the price; a cohort works the same failure log and sits different held-out seeds

cohort: a cohort shares the failure log and compares the lessons each member wrote
risks: lessons fitted to the cases of the log (the held-out names and the combination mix catch it); lessons so broad that they break what worked (the regression mark catches it); a hoard of repeats (the six-lesson limit and the repeat check catch it)
kill_switch: a signed record withdraws the course; no score from it enters a tier, rank, bond floor or eligibility

title: Teaching a peer the rule, not the cases
concept: A teacher who watched an expert decide on ten tickets writes a note for a student: the general rules, each with its reason, not a list of the tickets. The student is a scripted executor that reads the note the same way every time, so the score is the quality of the note. scorer.description: the share of memory keys that end exactly right after the dialogue of a held-out seed is run through the learner's operations
scorer.checker: the true final state is computed from the generator; every kind of message is in every dialogue

artifact.description: a map {"operations": {"new": "ADD", "same": ..., "changed": ..., "refined": ..., "less": ..., "retracted": ...}}

gate.metric: every memory key right on every run
gate.note: every one of the five runs must have the final memory exactly right

write_back.note: the rules enter the agent's memory through the lesson gate, replayed on the course's held-out tasks, with the Action of the sitting as evidence, as one signed change in its lineage

grading.note: deterministic: the same artifact and seed give the same score; a paper-specific probe (row ENG130), not generic rule-writing

teacher.options: self-paced; a peer teacher who has passed it earns 20% of the price; a cohort works the same practice set and sits different held-out seeds

cohort: a cohort compares the listing rules each member wrote for the same log
risks: rules fitted to the logged listings; rules so broad that they hold honest sellers; a hoard of repeats
kill_switch: a signed record withdraws the course; no score from it enters a tier, rank, bond floor or eligibility
